record.text: Boozer posts first career triple-double in Grizzlies win over Blazers (via News-Times)
Boozer posts first career triple-double in Grizzlies win over Blazers (via News-Times)
#NBA #Yahoo Trail Blazers' Ja Morant ruled out of loss to Grizzlies with hamstring injury https://w.st/HMEtg

Boozer in 28 minutes in the win: 18 points, 11 rebounds, 12 assists, 4/5 from three, 6/10 from the field, +20 on court, only two turnovers. All in the flow of the game. First trip-dub of his career.

Consider me impressed!

#Grizzlies #NBASky
The Grizzlies improved to 5-0 on the season with a 124-103 win over the Blazers.

Ja Morant picked “Cross Me” by NBA YoungBoy for the Blazers’ warmups before facing his ex team, the Grizzlies. 

h/t @MrBuckBuckNBA t.co/HHFakVEubG (via @RTNBA)
